diff --git a/src/_pytest/inline_exception.py b/src/_pytest/inline_exception.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..a885ca087
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_pytest/inline_exception.py
@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+
+
+if sys.version_info < (3, 11):
+    from exceptiongroup import BaseExceptionGroup
+
+
+def inline_exception(exc: BaseException, include_subexception_msg: bool = True) -> str:
+    """Return the message and notes of ``exc`` as a single line.
+
+    Same as :func:`_pytest._code.code.stringify_exception`, but the message
+    and notes are joined with ``"; "`` instead of newlines.
+    """
+    try:
+        notes = getattr(exc, "__notes__", [])
+    except KeyError:
+        # Workaround for https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/98778 on
+        # Python <= 3.9, and some 3.10 and 3.11 patch versions.
+        HTTPError = getattr(sys.modules.get("urllib.error", None), "HTTPError", ())
+        if sys.version_info < (3, 12) and isinstance(exc, HTTPError):
+            notes = []
+        else:  # pragma: no cover
+            # exception not related to above bug, reraise
+            raise
+    if not include_subexception_msg and isinstance(exc, BaseExceptionGroup):
+        message = exc.message
+    else:
+        message = str(exc)
+
+    return "; ".join(
+        [
+            message,
+            *notes,
+        ]
+    )
diff --git a/testing/test_inline_exception.py b/testing/test_inline_exception.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..3276a1a1a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_inline_exception.py
@@ -0,0 +1,56 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+
+from _pytest._code.code import stringify_exception
+from _pytest.inline_exception import inline_exception
+import pytest
+
+
+if sys.version_info < (3, 11):
+    from exceptiongroup import ExceptionGroup
+
+
+def test_message_only() -> None:
+    assert inline_exception(ValueError("boom")) == "boom"
+
+
+def test_empty_message() -> None:
+    assert inline_exception(ValueError()) == ""
+
+
+def test_notes_joined_with_semicolon() -> None:
+    exc = ValueError("boom")
+    exc.__notes__ = ["first", "second"]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert inline_exception(exc) == "boom; first; second"
+    assert stringify_exception(exc) == "boom\nfirst\nsecond"
+
+
+def test_empty_message_with_notes() -> None:
+    exc = ValueError()
+    exc.__notes__ = ["note"]  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    assert inline_exception(exc) == "; note"
+
+
+def test_exception_group_message() -> None:
+    exc = ExceptionGroup("group", [ValueError("inner")])
+    assert inline_exception(exc) == str(exc)
+    assert inline_exception(exc, include_subexception_msg=False) == "group"
+
+
+def test_http_error_notes_workaround() -> None:
+    from urllib.error import HTTPError
+
+    exc = HTTPError("url", 404, "Not Found", None, None)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+    assert inline_exception(exc) == stringify_exception(exc)
+
+
+def test_notes_lookup_error_reraised() -> None:
+    class Broken(Exception):
+        def __getattr__(self, name: str) -> object:
+            raise KeyError(name)
+
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        inline_exception(Broken("x"))
+    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
+        stringify_exception(Broken("x"))
notes:
Added src/_pytest/inline_exception.py, a standalone copy of stringify_exception's logic (notes lookup with the HTTPError KeyError workaround, ExceptionGroup message handling, re-raise otherwise) that joins with "; " instead of newlines; code.py is unchanged. Tests in testing/test_inline_exception.py compare it against stringify_exception.
